topic: Long range guidance: Inertial navigation, Hybrid inertial system and air flying missile guidance.
syllabus_extract: Long range guidance: Inertial navigation, Hybrid inertial system and air flying missile guidance.
specific_objectives: 22.1.1.1Trainee will be able to understand the basic of guided weapon systems and types of targets.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of Inertial Navigation System components and Missile Guidance modes using L & Ds and IB.
intro_questions: What are the primary types of long-range guidance systems?
Define the basic principle of inertial navigation.
List the common types of targets for guided weapons.

development.content:
Basic principles of inertial navigation
Components of inertial navigation system
Error accumulation in inertial systems
Hybrid inertial system architecture
Integration of GPS with INS

Air-to-air missile guidance modes
Air-to-surface missile guidance modes
Terminal guidance techniques
Missile seeker types and operation
Guidance law selection criteria

topics: Comparison of inertial and hybrid systems
development.content:
Comparison of inertial and hybrid systems
Advantages of hybrid inertial guidance
Limitations of pure inertial navigation
Future trends in missile guidance
Operational considerations for aircrew

summary_questions: Explain how a hybrid inertial system corrects drift errors.
Differentiate between semi-active and active radar homing in missiles.
Describe the role of the inertial reference unit in a missile.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the specific guidance units and reference units discussed in the next lesson plan (LP 09) and how they interface with the inertial system.
